notes:
Account: large fintech platform building customer-facing assistants and sensitive-doc search. Strong requirement: customer-managed keys (BYOK) + HSM-backed root keys. Primary ask: private VPC deployment with Redwood private control plane, KMS integration (AWS KMS + CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault HSM, GCP KMS CMEK) and secure key import workflow.

Security/context: needs audit logs shipped to Splunk and internal SIEM, 7+ year retention for certain records, EU data residency for all token payloads. Must support SSO/SAML + SCIM, SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence. FIPS 140-2/3 validation for HSMs is required for root material.

Why Redwood: interested in unified runtime + private deployment option; Redwood's routing/fallback story appeals (ability to degrade to smaller local model when KMS latency spikes). Concern: key operation latency and effect on per-request tail-latency. Also legal wants explicit constraints on cross-region key usage and remote key wrapping.

Decision factors: BYOK onboarding friction, HSM attestation & transfer of custody, logging/retention guarantees, per-key rotation automation, support for envelope encryption model, clear escalation path for key compromise.

Recent quote: "We need a deterministic key flow that our compliance team can sign off on — no black-box key handling." — Head of Cloud Security (SV).
